title: fix: refine zero-pollen authorization notice
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Uses a wider, softly highlighted zero-Pollen notice on the authorization screen
- Aligns the shared wallet icon with the notice title and keeps the text neutral
- Preserves the existing Quest and Top up links that open in a new tab
- Fixes the shared Alert title typing for composed React content

Checks:
- `npm run typecheck --prefix packages/ui`
- `npx tsc --noEmit`
- `npx vite build --config frontend/vite.config.ts`

gist.headline: A gentler empty wallet
gist.blurb: The authorization screen now gives a zero-Pollen wallet a little more room to explain itself. Same useful Quest and Top up exits, fewer cramped pixels.
gist.summary: Refined the authorization screen’s zero-Pollen notice with a wider soft highlight, aligned wallet icon and title, neutral copy, and React-content support in the shared Alert title.
gist.impact: People authorizing with zero Pollen will see a clearer, calmer notice while retaining the existing Quest and Top up links in new tabs.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli helping a small wallet-shaped notice bloom into a wide, welcoming sign at a cozy authorization desk. A Quest map and a Top up watering can sit nearby as clear, friendly paths forward, with a neatly aligned wallet icon and little code-flowers around the terminal.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-dark-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny librarian scarf, gently straightening a wide softly glowing wallet notice beside a retro authorization terminal; a Quest map and a small Top up watering can lead toward blooming code-plants. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, dark purple (#110518) details, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with subtle pixel-font text: 'YOU HAVE OPTIONS'.
